summary_1line: After Pandu’s funeral rites, Vyasa warns of the dynasty’s doom, Bhima bullies the Kauravas in childhood, and Duryodhana plots to kill him.

image_candidates.scene_text: Vyasa solemnly warns Satyavati of the coming destruction of the Kuru dynasty while grieving citizens fill the halls of Hastinapura.
Young Bhima shakes a fruit tree with a kick, sending both fruits and the clinging Kaurava princes tumbling to the ground.
On the flower-filled banks of the Ganga, the princes arrive at a richly decorated water-sport palace hung with banners and surrounded by lotus ponds.
